column1: # index elision parity at multi-GB scale — the invariant Layer J actually certifies.
# For each class, the sorted files-with-matches list was captured twice over the
# multi-GB corpus, once with the persisted index and once with --no-index, and the two
# md5 digests compared. Identical digests mean the index changed no answer: it only
# ever elided reads. This is the package's central operational guarantee, and it is
# asserted absolutely — any divergence fails Layer J closed, with no tolerance.
# These are the three classes whose file counts fall short of csearch's in
# scale_race.tsv, chosen deliberately: if a shortfall were index unsoundness it would
# show up here as DIVERGENT. It does not, which localizes the gap to corpus selection
# (the tree walk's ignore/binary heuristics), not the index. See scale_truth.tsv for
# the -uu measurement that confirms it: `})` recovers 27927 -> 28148 of ripgrep's 28156.
